notes: Menus close easier: swipe them down, or tap the ✕ at the top right
Timer types in your order: hold and drag in the Type list, A to Z in 1 tap, or Reset
Demo videos for 297 moves: tap ▶ when picking a move, or during the workout
Fixed: the coach voice could fall back to the robot voice on phones. It now waits for the voice to load, and Timer settings shows when it is ready
Ladder: each rung's time is listed under the totals
History: the clock button at the top shows every workout with its time and reps. Do it again or save it in 1 tap
Saved workouts now sit first in Quick picks
Ladder: each move can Climb, go as a Pyramid or stay the Same. Rung reps now read on one line
Picking a move: tap ▶ to see it before you choose
New: Rep goal. Set your totals (200 push-ups, 75 pull-ups…), pick EMOM, Ladder, Sets or For time, and the timer builds the workout
New: You go, I go. Your rest is as long as your set took. Burpee Club 300, 500 and 1,000 push-ups inside burpees
New coach voices: Coach Kevin, Tess, Dominic and Louise (Timer settings, Coach voice). They know every move by name, with a coaching cue for each
Getting ready for new studio coach voices: more things for the coach to say, and a cue for every move
Quick picks: ready-made workouts for every timer type, easy to hard (Pull-up 150, Cindy, Murph, Chelsea and more)
For time: tap your reps in as you go (+5, +10, +20) and watch the bar fill to 100%
Fixed: the move library was empty, and the Start bar floated up the screen while scrolling
New users see how to put the timer on their home screen, step by step for their phone
The Training Timer now speaks French: pick Français in Timer settings (it follows your phone's language)
New timer type: VO2 max, with 5 proven protocols (Norwegian 4×4, Huberman 2×2, Zone 5 bike, 20/40 sprints, the 1-minute workout)
Cleaner coach voice: the room echo is mostly gone, and the female voice is softer
The coach calls every round (halfway, last two, last round), never talks over the beeps, and every phone now shows the same timer rings
Timer sound is more reliable: it wakes back up after a call, Siri or a notification
Fine-tune the coach voice: Timer settings, under Coach voice
Pick a male or female coach voice in Timer settings. No sound on iPhone? Turn off silent mode: the timer plays over your music, and the silent switch mutes it
Nico's own voice coaches you now, tap a move to add weight mid-workout, and the end screen shows your totals, load and last time
Hold a move and drag it to change the order, when setting up and during the workout
Your music keeps playing during a workout: the timer now plays over it (turn on Sound on silent mode in Timer settings if you train without music)
Hold − or + to go fast, Tabata logs your reps and every round, and colors are simpler: a main color, a second color, and a preview
Weights sit right under the reps, and tapping lb switches everything to kg (and back)
Setting up moves uses the same slim rows as the workout, any move can carry a weight (+lb), and the move you're on glows with white text
Timer types are listed simplest first: Stopwatch, Interval timer, Tabata, EMOM, AMRAP, For time, Ladder, Death By, Push-up test
Ladder and Death By show every setting up front, Customize says Pick your exercises when that is all it holds, and ladder moves have a divider
The final Chrono, LED and Laser ring designs are in: LED glows with a white core, Laser is a brighter beam
The timer is now called Training Timer
Timer is now called Interval timer, and its Customize reads Repeat the whole thing, with the break in between only when you repeat
Segmented rings drop one square at a time, even on short timers
The move you're on lights up in the list with the neon glow, and the Next box is gone
Tabata with 2 moves is 16 rounds, 8 of each, alternating, and you can lower or raise it
Picking a move: your favorites (tap the star), recent picks, suggestions like them, and the fundamentals come first, with all the other moves underneath
During a workout, timed moves go up and down 5 seconds at a time, and Done after a workout goes straight back to the timer without a color flash
Moves look the same in every timer: one slim row each, the full name on one line, small − and + for the reps
EMOM, Death By and Tabata: the clock is front and center, tap Done to clock each round, fix your reps with − +, and watch your rounds and total reps add up
Timed moves like planks go up and down 5 seconds at a time, the move list shows pictures, and Stopwatch starts as soon as you pick it
Ladders never hit 0: a dropping ladder stops at 1 rep, so 20 down by 2 ends at 2 and comes back

Round done now celebrates (buzz, chime, sparks), AMRAP logs every round with its time and lets you fix the reps, the ladder shows your progress rung by rung, and moves filter by body part, level and equipment
Ring glare works: a light streak and sparkle on the glass, with a size control in the lab
Timer look: swipe through the ring designs at full size and pick your colours (Timer settings → Timer look)
Timer ring: pick Chrono, LED or Laser in Timer settings
Segmented rings now drop one whole segment at a time
Ring lab: Core softness and Core brightness, so the white core can melt into the ring colour
notes_fr: Les menus se ferment plus facilement : glisse vers le bas, ou touche le ✕ en haut à droite
Les types de minuteur dans ton ordre : maintiens et glisse dans la liste, De A à Z en 1 geste, ou Réinitialiser
Vidéos de démonstration pour 297 exercices : touche ▶ en choisissant un exercice, ou pendant la séance
Corrigé : la voix du coach pouvait repasser en voix robot sur téléphone. Elle attend maintenant d’être chargée, et les Réglages indiquent quand elle est prête
Échelle : le temps de chaque palier s’affiche sous les totaux
Historique : le bouton horloge en haut montre chaque séance avec son temps et ses reps. Refais-la ou enregistre-la en 1 geste
Tes séances enregistrées sont en tête des Séances express
Échelle : chaque exercice peut monter, faire une pyramide ou rester constant. Les reps du palier tiennent sur une ligne
Choisir un exercice : touche ▶ pour le voir avant
Nouveau : Objectif reps. Fixe tes totaux (200 pompes, 75 tractions…), choisis EMOM, Échelle, Séries ou For Time, le minuteur construit la séance
Nouveau : Chacun son tour. Ton repos dure autant que ta série. Burpee Club 300, 500 et 1 000 pompes dans des burpees
Nouvelles voix de coach : Coach Kevin, Tess, Dominic et Louise (Réglages du minuteur, Voix du coach). En anglais, avec le nom et un conseil pour chaque exercice
En préparation : de nouvelles voix de coach studio, plus de phrases variées et un conseil pour chaque exercice
Séances express : des séances prêtes pour chaque type de minuteur, de facile à difficile (Tractions 150, Cindy, Murph, Chelsea et plus)
For Time : ajoute tes répétitions au fur et à mesure (+5, +10, +20) et regarde la barre se remplir jusqu’à 100 %
Corrigé : la bibliothèque d’exercices était vide, et la barre Démarrer remontait à l’écran pendant le défilement
Les nouveaux utilisateurs voient comment mettre le minuteur sur leur écran d’accueil, étape par étape pour leur téléphone
